tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe chog 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs/

bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la gnyis te/ thog mar bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang bsnyen pa las su rung nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la 'jug tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa dang ldan pas gnas dben par khrus bya zhing*/ gtsang sbra dang ldan pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku mdog dmar po bye ru'i mdog can 'od zer dmar po 'khrigs pa zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng du 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ pad zla'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ bar bsams la mchod pa/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhū baṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai we te/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dngas shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/

oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥṇāṃ ad+yā nud+pa n+na twa d+ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhugs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā t+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai we te/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+na i daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcos/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po ste/ /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang*/ /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la/ /so so so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /me tog dri dang bdug pa gtor mar bcas/ / 'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gi dge ba'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa dang de'i bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces 'phrin las bcol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

badz+ra muḥ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ 'dul 'dzin dang paṇa chen gyi cho gar phyogs skyong gi gtor ma gtor tshul mi snang yang 'dir kha bskang ba yin no/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje yod na maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing*/ gzhan ma phul kyang rung*/ mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlab/ 'dir mchod pa byin brlab bya ba ni/ kha cig tshogs zhing dang*/ gzhan dag bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa yin zer yang*/ tshogs zhing gi ched du bshams pa yin na ma gtogs bdag bskyed kyi mchod par gsal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don sgrub slad du/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gson/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ /deng nas byang chub sems bskyed do/ /zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed/ de nas/ rang tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can nas tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/ /oṃ sarbā ta thā ga ta kā ya wā k+tsi t+ta badz+ra pra na ma me na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bā da ban+dha nāṃ ka ro me/ zhes phyag bya/ rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥlas byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ bar bsam zhing so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ ār+ya a pa ri mi ta ā yu r+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma la shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yi zhabs bsil/ puṣes me tog /dhū bes bdug spos/ a lo kes snang gsal/ gan+dhes dri chab/ nai we t+yes zhal zas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṭa sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/

gis rol mo rnams kyis mchod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub sbyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra muḥtshogs rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig / ces lan gsum mam gcig gis tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sar+b+ba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs su 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'bar ba'i rang bzhin bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu bskal pa 'jig pa'i me lta bu'i kha dog sna lnga'i me dpung phyogs bcur 'phro bar gyur/ par bsam/ ra ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+ruṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/

phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa'i rin po che'i pha gu ser po/ /de'i steng du chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa la/ dril bu dang rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i phyir ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can la ba dan dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ phyi nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po bzhis bskor ba/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa/ rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i ra ba me ri dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi sa gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus dkar ba/ bya rgyud kyi lha'i bskyed tshul la lha drug bskyed dang cho ga gsum bskyed gnyis yod pa las/ paṇa chen gyi der lha drug bskyed 'byung yang*/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i der cho ga gsum bskyed 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang de bzhin du bya ste/ der paṃ yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams kyi gnas su a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa re re/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las tshe dpag med lha dgu'i bdag nyid du gyur pa ni/

dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ byang shar du kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ shar lhor yon tan tshe dpag med/ lho nub tu ye shes tshe dpag med/ nub byang du mi g.yo ba tshe dpag med/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po byi ru'i mdog can/ 'od zer dmar po 'khrigs pa zhi ba'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng du 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs pa/ pad zla'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ kha cig tu dar dang zhes 'byung yang 'dul 'dzin pa'i der mi snang zhing*/ 'og tu dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' zhes 'byung bas mi dgos so/ /lha tshogs de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can nas tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnams byangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/

/yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje cher ldan pa/ / dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur sbyon tshur sbyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥm hā kā ru ṇī kā at+ma ka e h+ye hi/ zhes spyan drangs la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ / tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarbā ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta a yuḥdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ ces pa nas shap+ta pā tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/

dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / zhes pa nas/ khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba nas shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa sngar byin gyis ma brlabs na 'dir sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /mgon po tshe dpag med pa dang*/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul/ /ci bder bar ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ/ zhes pa nas/ nai we te'i bar dang*/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /oṃ ār+ya a pa ri nas shap+ta pratī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de nas rdor dril dang bcas te bstod pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ /sems can sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /skad cig nyid la sel mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung zhing*/ /nyes pa'i dri ma kun 'joms pa/ /rdo rje lus can rdo rje can/ /rdo rje tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /bsam pa'i dngos kun skad cig gis/ /rang 'dod bzhin du tshim mdzad pa/ /mchog gi bdag po chen po ste/ /rin chen tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /ji ltar nyon mongs dri ma yis/ /kun nas gos par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /thugs rjes chags tshul ston mdzad cing*/

/pad+ma tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /'dod pa'i las rnams ma lus pa/ /skad cig nyid la rdzogs mdzad pa/ khams kun 'phel byed dpag bsam shing*/ /las kyi tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /sna tshogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /'khor ba'i skyabs mdzad dpa' bo ste/ /kun gzigs tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /stobs chen rnams kyis rab brgyan te/ /ma lus mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa/ /ston pa sred med bu yi mthu/ /yon tan tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /me long mnyam nyid la sogs pa'i/ /ye shes mang po'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rtog pa ma lus khyod kyis spangs/ /ye shes tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ / rnam rtog rlung gis khyod mi g.yo/ /mtha' bral ting 'dzin zhi ba ste/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'joms mdzad pa/ /mi g.yo tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa/ /khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la/ /tshe dang ye shes sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod la chu thigs ltar bstod pas/ /bdag gi 'dod pa rdzogs gyur te/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /rin chen pad+ma las byung ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis legs zhes kyang*/ /snyan pa'i bka' de thob par shog /ces pa 'am/ nyi gzhon 'char ka mas bstod na'ang legs/ rin chen dang pad+ma gnyis la 'dul 'dzin pa'i der snga phyi ldog ste 'byung zhing*/ paṇa chen gyi cho ga'i bdag bskyed gtso rkyang yin la/ mdun bskyed las rin chen gyi bstod pa sngon du 'byung ba ltar 'dir bkod pa ni lha bskyed cing sngags bzla ba'i rim pa dang yang mthun pas legs par rtogs so/ /'on kyang bya rgyud kyi bdag bskyed la ni gtso bo ma gtogs pa 'khor gyi bsnyen pa mi byed do/ /de nas lha'i sku la gsal bar dmigs te/ /sems bzung de la skyon/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥ'i mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/

sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi yon tan dang mthu stobs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par hrīḥl thim par gyur/ bar bsam/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ na mo bruṃ ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ.a ro yik+ka hūṃ hrīḥ zhes snying po dag oṃ tad+ya thā/ a pa ri mi ta ā ur+dzña na hrīḥhūṃ bh+ruṃ swā hā/ zhes mtshan sngags dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzña na su baṃ ni sh+tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arda te saṃ mya k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ pu ṇ+ye pu ṇ+ye ma hā pu ṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta pu ṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta pu ṇ+ye/ dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha dharmā te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring rnams ci nus bzla/ 'dul 'dzin dang paṇa chen gyi cho ga gnyis kar 'dir 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs bzlas na legs par bshad do/ /mthar yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskangs nas/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod de/ bstod pa rgyas pa 'am/ yang na/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ skabs 'dir 'don char mi snang yang 'dul 'dzin pa'i cho ga las/ rang gi spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med/ thugs kar rigs lnga tshe dpag med rang dang 'dra ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ lha mi'i rig 'dzin thams cad kyi tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub ma lus pa 'od zer gyi rnam pas spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med la thim/ de yang zhu nas rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar gyi rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas lus kyi zung dang sems kyi rten du gyur cing*/

tshe dpag med kyi sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur nas 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par gyur/ snyam du bsams te byin rlabs zhu bar bshad cing*/ paṇa chen gyi der yang phyogs 'dra bar snang bas byas na khyad che'o/ /thun mthar gtor ma 'bul na/ byin gyis brlabs la ye shes pa mdun du spyan drangs nas phu ste mchod bstod bzod gsol sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i tshe/ bum pa sta gon ma gtogs gzhan rnams ji bzhin dgos pa'i nges pa med na'ang*/ 'dir rdul tshon gyi dbang du byas nas 'dul 'dzin pa'i gsung ltar 'chad pa la gsum/ sa'i cho ga /sta gon gyi cho ga /dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gtso bor bskyed de/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ nas rol mo rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ a ka ros phul la/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas lag tu spos thogs dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis blang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas a mri ta bzlas pa'i nyungs dkar dang chu dang thal ba gtor zhing sbyar ba bya/ de bzlas pa'i ba byung dang dri bzang gis byug /sbos chus bsang gtor bya'o/ /sa'i lha mo la blang bar 'dod na 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho gas bya'o/ /de nas sa de lag pas mnan la gtso bo'i sngags lan bdun brjod cing*/

sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'chi med rnga sgra'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /snyam du blos bzung*/ de nas shar du phyogs pas 'dug la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa la zhug gi bar du bsgom/ de nas hūṃ badz+ra ud tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes pa dang rdo rje khu tshur gyis mdzub mo gnyis rtse mo sbyar ba 'og tu phyogs pas spyi bor bzung zhing dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg /rang nyid gtso bo las phye ba'i khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang ril bu 'dzin pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur/ bar bsam zhing*/ hūṃ? zhes brjod cing pad skor bya zhing rdo rje gsor dril bu gsol zhing dkyil 'khor la bskor te/ dbang ldan du sleb pa dang*/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la thug gi bar 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam/ rgyas pa la spro na/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas bka' bsgo zhing*/ a mṛ ta dang khro bo'i sngags brjod/ de nas phur bu rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ bzhi las sna tshogs rdo rje bzhi/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las khro bo rdo rje phur bu stod bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zhing g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte ba man chad mdung rtsi gcig pa'i dbyibs can gyi phur bu me dpung rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ tho ba bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje tho ba me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ bar bsam/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bkug ste/ rdo rje'i ra ba'i phyi me ri'i nang du hūṃ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa rnams su bcug par gyur par bsam/

hūṃ zhes brjod de spyi bo nas phur bu btsugs la/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba duṣ+taṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ro a dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes brjod de grwa bzhir gdab/ dbang ldan nas brtsams nas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phur bus btab pas/ lus ngag yid gsum g.yo 'gul med par gyur/ de nas bsnyen pa dang srung 'khor bskor mo/ /gnyis pa sta gon la bzhi las/ dang po sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbu ma mu dri'i thig le byas la/ me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ chu bzhi dang mchod pa rnams bshams der paṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo ser mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can zhi ba/ na bza' dkar po bsnams pa/ rgyan bzang po sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bskyed la/ lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i steng du hūṃ gsum gyis mtshan par gyur par bsam ste rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sor mo'i rtse mos sa la lan gsum bsnum pa dang de'i sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ sa g.yos pa'i gseb nas sa'i lha mo ye shes pa thon pa dang 'dres nas/ bdag gis ci bgyi ba bka' stsol cig ces gsung bar gyur par bsam/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas so so'i sngags phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ pri thaṃ wi de wi sa pā ri wa ra pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du bā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil dang*/ añtsa ma ṇaṃ gis zhal bsil dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇi gis bsang gtor phul nas/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi sa pā ri wa ra puṣ+be pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+tha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ ces pa nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas rdo ba dril spos dang bcas pas/

skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ de ltar bgyis shig ces gsung ste de nyid du thim nas sa'i ngo bor gnas par gyur par bsam la lag pa rdo rje nang bsdams bya ste/ sa de mnan la oṃ badz+ri bha wa hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i hūṃ yig 'od zer 'bar ba 'phros pas dbang chen gyi gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar rdo rjer byas par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍha tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ lha gnas nges pa'i phyir thig gdab dgos pas/ thig skud kyi rgyun/ gtsang zhing mnyam pa'i ras bal lam/ skra ma 'dres pa dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa'am/ gzhon nu ma ma nyams pas bka' ba'am/ yang na dam tshig can gyis bka' bas kyang rung ste/ de yang kha dog dkar po sum sgril 'jur mdud med cing bka' legs pa/ dpon slob gnyis kyi mdzub mo nas sor mo'i bar du bcug cing*/ drangs nas rdo rje khu tshur du byas pa la mdzub mo'i rgyab sa la sbyar ba ma gtogs pa/ ring ba dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur/ sbom phra sgo'i nyi shu'i cha yod pa la dri zhim po'i chu dang*/ phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ba'i rnam lnga byugs/ thig skud kyi nang gi mtha' gnyis dang dbus su oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa bsam/ dris byugs pa'i gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag / rang nyid sngar ltar gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ thig skud la a mri tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ thig skud stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyo bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ? gi 'od zer gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ? baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ par bsam/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ nas shrī yi hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ rang gi rang bzhin zhi ba las/ zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ de nas lag pas reg cing*/ 'khyil pa bzlas te bsrung*/ mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba ser por gyur/ badz+ra ḍiṣ+ti ma ṭa/ zhes brtan par byas la/ 'khyil pa bzlas pa'i phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga'i chu dang*/ nyungs kar dang dri'i chus gtor la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pas reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su tra ma te kra ma hūṃ/ zhes pa gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas lha gnas bya'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ shodha ni hūṃ/ ces dri'i chus bsang gtor bya/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ sngar gyi bstod pa bya/ de nas rang gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sgrub grogs bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed/ de nas slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar nas phan tshun ma nor bar phyogs te/ phyogs thams cad rang bzhin med pa mnyam pa nyid du gyur par mos nas rang dang slob ma'i mig gnyis dzā dzā las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can du gyur par bsgoms te slob dpon gyis g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis lte bar thig skud bzung la/

dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes brjod cing slob mas kyang de dag brjod de drangs la g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung*/ rang rkang pa g.yon pa skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ g.yas pa sa la btsugs slob ma de las zlog ste bsdad nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes shar nub kyi tshangs thig gdab/ de nas/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur par bsam ste/ g.yas skor du phyin nas slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas pas lho byang gi tshangs thig gdab/ de nas slob dpon me dang slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang*/ slob dpon bden bral dang slob ma dbang du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab/ slob dpon me dang slob ma de nyid du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon rlung dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas nub kyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon me dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas lho'i rtsa thig dang*/ de nas rang gtso bor gsal ba'i mig gnyis su hrī hrī las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer 'bar ba can gyi lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bur gyur par bsam zhing nub nas shar du phyogs te g.yon rkyang du gnas pa'i lag pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu dkur bzung nas/ hī hī zhes brjod cing g.yon dang g.yas su 'gying ba re bya/ thar pa'i sgo'i bgegs su gyur pa'i sgrib pa rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ /snyam du mos la dri bzang po'i chus sgo'i tshangs thig dang rtsa thig gnyis phrad pa'i g.yas g.yon la cha chung gnyis gnyis tshangs thig dang bcas pa phyis la sgo bzhi dbye bar bya'o/ /de nas thig lhag ma rnams skor phyogs la sogs pa spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de nas zlum thig gi tshe phur bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ldeng gi phur bu stod rdo rje rtse lnga pa smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can du gyur bar bsam la sngar gyi rdung ba'i sngags kyis dbus su gdab/

phur bu med na'ang bsgoms nas de ltar bya'o/ /de la thig skud btags te rta babs nas cha chen gcig song bar/ rwa rtse nas skor thig dang*/ de nas cha phran gnyis song bar pad+ma dang*/ de nas cha phran gnyis kyi rdo rje dang*/ de nas cha chen gcig gis 'od 'phreng dang*/ nang thig ni/ tshangs thig nas cha phran lnga song bar lte ba'i don dang de nas cha phran bcu song ba nas 'dab ma dang*/ de nas cha phran gcig gi mu khyud de 'dab ma rnams kyi gcus thig ni gzhan dang mthun no/ /thig rnams thebs nas thig skud la chu gnyis nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bgegs gshegs gsol bya'o/ /de nas lha gnas rnams su rang rang gi sngags brjod cing dri bzang po'i chus gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi dang*/ gzhan rnams su zlum po bya'o/ /me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ mchod pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ re re yang bcu las mi nyung bar bya/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas nub tu phyogs par 'dug cing*/ bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'am/ yang na gtso bo bskyed/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la a mṛ tas bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs nas gzhal yas khang gdan bcas kyi bar bskyed/ lha rnams kyi gnas gsum byin brlab kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ thugs ka'i hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros/ sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' bteg pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig brten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dbyer med du thim par gyu par bsams la/ de nas sgrub thabs ltar dbang bskur rgyas btab la mchod bstod rgyas pa bya'o/ /gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ rgyas par ni bum pa bcu'am/ med na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis su bsdu zhing hūṃ lan bdun bzlas pa'i skud pa dkar po bdun gyis ras bal la sogs pa'i mgul 'chings kyi steng du dkri/ 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla zhing gu gul gyis bdug

/nyungs kar gyis brdeg rta glang bong bus ma bgrod pa'i chu gtsang mas ran par dgang*/ gser dngul mu tig byi ru pad+ma rā ga ste med na zangs sam/ dung ste rin po che lnga/ gro nas til mon sran 'bras so ba ste 'bru lnga/ bri ha ti/ ka nā ka ti/ ha sa de ba/ a ba ra dzi ta/ daṇ+ḍa u pa la ste sman lnga/ ga bur/ gur kum/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ dza ti ste dri ldan rnams bum pa'i nang du gzhug /'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du hūṃ gis bsngags pa'i dung chos sam/ rdza phor du phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri bzang gis chus dgang*/ de'i steng du me tog gi phreng ba dbus su bcings pa'i rdo rje bzhag /sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar gyi ku sha'i gdan la 'khod/ de nas bum pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bum pa gnyis sogs yod na rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gcig las mang na baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ta p+te ta p+te ma hā ta p+te swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bsdu na des chog la/ rgyas pa la spro na bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang gdan bcas kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams kyi gnas su/ ces pa nas/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kha cig lha dgu'i bdag nyid du gyur pa ni zhes pa bdag bskyed la sbyor zhing*/ bum bskyed la ngo bor gyur zhes dang*/ mdun bskyed la dkyil 'khor du gyur zhes bsgyur dgos zer ba mi 'thad de/ bdag nyid du gyur pa ni ngo bor gyur pa'am bdag nyid can du gyur zhes pa'i don yin gyi bdag bskyed du gyur pa'i don ma yin pa'i phyir ro/

/bum pa gnyis yod na/ las bum gyi nang du dang med na/ gtso bo'i g.yon du paṃ las pad+ma dang āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyan gsum pa mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha tshogs de thams cad kyi spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po/ ces pa nas/ tshe dpag med lha dgu dang khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sangs rgyas dang ces pa nas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ zhes sogs spyan 'dren rgyas bsdus cing rigs dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan pa dang*/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la 'bul ba ni/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /yon chab rgyun yang mi chad pa/ /bum pa'i lha yi tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ār+ya a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar du mchod/ bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ yang na 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ ces sogs dang*/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa/ /ces sogs dang*/ rang gi rang bzhin zhi ba las/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor sku/ /ma rung tshar gcod rdo rje can/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ/ zhes pa ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun bzlas nas/

dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ lha so so'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ sku'i cha nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa rnams bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med par gyur/ oṃ bai ro tsa na ā yur+dzñā na sed+dhi sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na= rat+na= pad+ma= karmā= sarba lo ke ter gu ṇa= dzñā na= a tsa la= rnams bcug ste/ brgya rtsa re'am yang na nyer gcig re bzla'o/ /de nas las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla zhing thun mong du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ brgya rtsa dang*/ gzungs ring yang bzla zhing*/ yig brgya lan bdun nam gsum bzla'o/ /de nas oṃ bai ro tsa na ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi sa ma ye hūṃ/ dang hūṃ lan bdun bzlas pa'i mchod yon phul/ 'khyil ba bzlas pa'i me tog gsum gzhug /de nas nyer spyod lnga dang rol mos mchod cing*/ 'khyil pa'i sngags dang*/ las bum gyi chus bsang zhing*/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs par srid du bgegs rnam par bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra muḥbum lha ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gi gnas su gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rnams bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur bar bsam mo/ /bzhi pa gzhan la dbang bskur ba'i tshe slob ma sta gon ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ces sogs kyis gsol gdab lan gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs gsum gyis skyabs sems 'dzin du 'jug /de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum byin brlab bya ba/

so shing*/ srung skud/ ku sha sbin pa rnams byas la/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ zhes sogs kyis spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ snyan gsan 'bebs pa/ dkyil 'khor nam mkha' 'degs pa'i bar rnams 'dul 'dzin pa'i cho gar bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la gsum/ ye thig gdab cing tshon dgye ba/ bum pa dgod cing rgyan dgram pa/ bsgrub cing mchod nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas thig skud dkar po lnga tshan tshon so sos kha sgyur/ snod so sor dbus dang phyogs bzhir dgod/ bsangs sbyangs nas rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lngar bskyed/ de nas rang gtso bo dang slob ma 'khyil bar bskyed pa gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo'i rtse mo nas mthe bo'i bar du sngo dkar dmar ser ljang ba'i rim pas bkod nas kyang rdzi ma bdegs shing rdebs pa 'bar ba'i lta bas rigs lnga bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ dīp+ta tiṣ+ṭha aṃ gu sha dzaḥbacom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po'i thig gdab pa'i phyir/ rdo rje'i thig bdag la stsol cig /'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus bkug pa'i ye shes kyi thig skud sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas btang ba lag pa'i thig skud so so la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sar+b+ba dhārmāḥ a t+yan ta a nu pā biṣ+ta sarba dhar+m+māḥ zhes gnyis kas brjod cing de rnams so sor sgril/ de nas gcig tu sgril/ de nas 'dri'i chu sogs kyis blugs pa dang yi ge gsum bkod pa la sogs pa las thig ltar bya/ dril byugs pa'i gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag ste/ chu gnyis nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod nas/ lag pas reg cing 'khyil pa bzlas la bsrung*/ zhes pa nas slob mas kyang brjod drangs/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung zhes pa'i bar las thig ltar byas la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang 'dzum mos thig skud gzung la/

se gol gyi skra dang bcas pas nam mkha' la gdab cing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ sgra des nam mkha' khyab pa'i sangs rgyas rnams bskul te byon nas thig skud la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas lag pa gnyis mnyam par thab la/ sngags de nyid brjod cing*/ tshangs thig dang po sa la gdab/ ngo bo ye shes la rnam pa srang bu kha dog lngar snang ba'i thig skud re chad nas las thig la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas rkang pa byin gyis brlabs te g.yas bskor du phyin nas/ lho byang gi tshangs thig nam mkha' dang sa gzhi la 'debs pa gong ltar bya/ de nas nam mkha' la gdab pa ma gtogs skor phyogs la sogs pa sngar ltar bya ste/ las thig gang yod du gdab/ thig thebs pa dang thig skud la sngar ltar mchod nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra muḥthig skud kyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kar gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas tshon rnams la hrīḥyig bri zhing gnas ma 'tshol bar dgod/ tshon rnams bsang sbyangs nas rnam snang tshe dpag med la sogs pa rigs lngar bskyed/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ dī p+ta tiṣ+ṭha aṃ gu sha dzaḥ 'bar ba'i lta stangs lcags kyu lta bus sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi tshon bkug ste dam tshig pa so so dang ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ de nas tshon rnams la ni zhes pa bris pa hi zhes brjod pas/ tshon rnams mang por sbar bar gyur par bsams la/ me tog nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod de/ de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyis phur bu bton te phur khung tshon sna lngas dgang*/ de nas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/ de yang rtsig pa lnga ni phyi nas sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba/ phyogs tshon ni shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes bzlos shing dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad du bri zhing*/

de nas rang ngam gzhan gyis ci bder bri'o/ /nang pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po lte ba ljang ge sar ser mu khyud sngon po la rdo rje dkar po/ rtsig pa'i steng gi sa lu ser po la rin po che'i phreng bas spras pa/ dra phyed kyi gzhi nag po la shar bu dang mda' yab dkar po/ rta babs kyi gser snam ser po/ shar bu rin po che sngar bzhin/ rta mig dang wa ran ṭa mdzes tshon/ mun pa gnyis nag po/ 'khor lo dang ri dwags ser po/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma dang glang rgyab kyi nang phyogs mdog /phyogs kyi rwa rgyal ba'i mdog /khyams ljang khu/ pad 'dab sna tshogs pa/ rdo rje ra ba'i gzhi sngon po la rdo rje dkar po/ 'od phreng kha dog sna tshogs pa/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po ri bri'o/ /de ltar bris zin pa dang tshon lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ ye thig ltar mchod pa dang gshegs gsol bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mchod pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du bshams/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas brgyan pa dang*/ gtor ma rnams sta gon bya/ 'chi blu byed na ji ltar bya dgos pa gzhan du shes/ gsum pa ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngar ltar byas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsdus te rang nyid la thim par gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ 'di ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i sngon du bdag bskyed bsgom pa'i mthar yang bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūṃ/ zhes 'byung ba ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skabs su rdo rje'i shugs kyis 'jug pa'i don yin pas/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i thog mar 'don dgos kyi/ kha cig bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed gang rung gi mjug nyid du sbyor rgyu yin snyam pa ni don min no/

/'on kyang de 'dul 'dzin pa'i cho gar 'byung gi /paṇa chen gyi der mi 'byung ngo*/ /de nas sngar gyi sngags de brjod nas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par mos te/ dkyil 'khor a mṛ tas bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa ces pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i nyi ma dang po'i dus su sta gon gyi lha 'bebs dgos pas/ de'i skabs kyang shes par bya'o/ /mchod pa a mṛ tas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ zhes pa nas/ mnyam par gyur/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ dang oṃ rū pa badz+ra āḥhūṃ/ nas oṃ sbar+sha badz+ra āḥhūṃ/ ge bar gyis byin brlab bya zhing*/ de nas/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /oṃ a pa ri mi tā yur+dzña na sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du shap+ta'i bar du sbyar la mchod/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra a brta ya a brta ya ho: 'dul 'dzin pa'i der mchod yon gyi mthar sngags 'di tsam las/ mchod pa gzhan mi 'byung ba ni bsdus pa'i dbang du byas shing*/ rgyas pa byed na sngags de ma brjod kyang chog la/ paṇa chen gyi der rol mo'i rjes su/ sna tshogs dbang po'i sogs kyis gos dang*/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe sogs kyis rgyan phul ba'i rjes su 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun bum pa bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams rim par 'bul bar bshad/ lhan thabs la lar 'dod yon rgyal srid kyi rjes su 'byung yang*/

gzhung gzhan phal cher las 'dod yon rgyal srid kyi sngon du 'byung ba mang bas 'dir yang de ltar bya'o/ /des na/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan du/ /gzugs mchog tshogs kyis bkang ba yang*/ /stong gsum la sogs ji bzhin du/ /zhum pa med par bcas te 'bul/ /oṃ a pa ri nas wa ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sgra snyan tshogs= dri mchog= ro mchog= reg bya'i= shap+ta= gan+dhe= ra sa= sbar+sha dang*/ 'khor lo= nor bu= btsun mo= blon po= glang po= rta mchog= dmag dpon= tsakra= ma ṇi= s+t+ri= pu ru ṣa= hasti= tu raṃ ga a shwa= khaṅga rat+na sbyar bas 'dod yon dang rgyal srid 'bul zhing*/ de nas rgyas par na bkra shis rtags brgyad dang gos rgyan bum pa rnams tshigs bcad ci rigs kyis 'bul bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje dril bzung la/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ /zhes pa nas/ snyan pa'i bka' de thob par shog /ces bstod/ de nas bsnyen par byed dam ma byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /de nas/ yi dam/ chos skyong*/ rgyal po bzhi'i gtor ma rnams byin brlab bya ba ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dngas shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur par bsam zhing*/ a ka ros byin gyis brlabs nas/ dang po ni/ mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtsi gcig pa dkar po'i dkyil sbu gu can rnams su gyur/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā shudzña na hrīḥhūṃ bh+ruṃ swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/ ces pa nas/ grih+na i daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs la phul nas/ chu gnyis nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod la/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ gnyis pa ni/

sgos kyi chos skyong la rang gi 'bul tshul ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ oṃ e h+ye hi tsa tu ra shrī ma hā rā dzā sa pa ri wa ra sa ma ye/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gyis gdan phul/ rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las ces pa nas/ can rnams su gyur/ oṃ ḍhi ḍa ra ṣ+tā ye/ oṃ bai ru ḍha ka ye/ oṃ bi ru pak+ṣa ye/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/ ces pa nas/ ba li ta ye swā hā/ ces lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ tsa tu ra shrī nas wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog mtshungs pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'phags skyes po la phyag= /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmangs ser sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /mig mi bzang la phyag= /ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal chen bzhi po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub can gyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /shar phyogs dri za'i gdon dang*/

lho phyogs grum bum gyi gdon dang*/ nub phyogs klu'i gdon dang*/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces 'phrin las bcos la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥrgyal po chen po bzhi rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod cing*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma yang spyi ltar gtong ngo*/ /de nas sgrub grogs a mṛ ta bzla zhing*/ dkyil 'khor srung du bcug ste/ rang sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu phyin nas/ cha gsum btong ba la/ gtor ma mchod pa bcas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe dharmā te badz+ra sid+dhi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba taṅkhi ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇaṃ a d+yā nu dān+na twar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha lo tsa ni sarba ar+b+ba sā dha ni swā hā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bden stobs brjod/ de nas spyan drang ba ni/ mgon po kun gshegs ces pa nas/ gsol/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dgas srin po klu/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gdon gyi bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/

/oṃ e h+ye hi da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ya swā hā/ oṃ ru tra ye/ oṃ sha ta sa ha sra oṃ ak+ṣi ye/ oṃ ak+ṇe ye/ oṃ ya ma ya/ oṃ ni re te ye/ oṃ ba ru ṇa ye/ oṃ ba ya bai ye/ oṃ ku bai ra ye/ oṃ ur+dhaṃ pra ha ma na ye/ su d+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra adhi ba ta ye/ oṃ ar+dh+wa pri shi wi bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gdan phul/ oṃ ru tra ye/ nas nā ge bh+yaḥs pā ri wa ra pra wa ra sad ka ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang pa'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon= /shar lho me lha'i tshogs= /mchod cing = /gshin rje lag na be con 'chang*/ /ma mo'i rgyal ba gdon gyi= /lho phyogs gdon= /mchod cing = /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin pa'i rgyal po gdon= /lho nub srin po'i tshogs = /mchod cing = /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon= /nub phyogs gdon= /mchod cing = /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po= /nub byang rlung lha'i= /mchod cing = /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug pa thogs/ /nor skyong gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /byang phyogs= /mchod= /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po= /byang shar dbang ldan= /mchod= / steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod= /'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes bstod do/ /gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ oṃ ru tra ye/ nas/ nā ga bh+yaḥs pā ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/

zhes sogs lan gsum dang*/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs bcas/ /ces pa nas/ bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces pas bsngo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces 'phrin las bcol/ gdon gyi rigs spyan 'dren pa ni/ lus kyi sbyong las sngar ltar byas la/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor tshogs bcas la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir sbyon cig /oṃ e h+ye hi lo ka kā ra ya/ de ba/ nā pa/ yak+ṣa/ gan+dhar pa/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /ma nu ṣa/ a ma nu ṣa/ sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ de ba/ nas wa ra pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gyis gdon phul/ oṃ de ba/ nas ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ oṃ de ba/ nas/ wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/ zhes sogs gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*/ /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*/ /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu ldeng ga chu ngogs dang*/ /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang*/ /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*/ khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*/ /las srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*/ /gang dag lam chen dang ni shing gcig drung*/

/dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*/ /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang*/ /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*/ /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces gnas smos pa'i sgo nas 'phrin las bcol lo/ /rang nyid skad cig gis hūṃ mdzad du gyur par bsams la/ de'i nga rgyal gyis phyag rgya byas te/ dzaḥsangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge 'dun= de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par can thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas che ge mo 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon gyi tshogs/ bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes bgegs 'khor brtsams mdun du bkug par bsam/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sa pā ri wa ra pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gyis gdan dgu la/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ nas ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ gung ga ri nas wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/ zhes sogs gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*/ /srin po sha rjen za ba

dang*/ /sems can rnams pa sna tshogs dang*/ /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po dang*/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phan chad spyad par gyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ /dul zhing yang dag bsdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yi bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod par ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung du gang dag gi /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de nye bar phyung nas su/ /gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gi 'dod pa skong bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*/ /'dir ni che ge mo zhig gi /nad de nye bar sol mdzod la/ /gdon rnams rang gi gnas su dengs/ /sarba bigh+nā na ga ts+tsha/ bgegs 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ oṃ de ba/ nas wa ra pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ sde brgyad 'khor bcas= oṃ ru tra ye/ nas ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ gats+tsha/ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su= na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā naṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ke te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis yi dgas la gtor ma sbyin/ de nas nye reg bya ste/ de'i tshul ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chu bzung*/ g.yas pa'i gung mo dang srin lag cung zad bkug par chu blangs te/ kha rna ba mig sna kha lag lte ba mgo rnams su reg cing chu hub gsum 'thung ste/ khu tshur gyis mchu la lan gnyis la phyi bar bya'o/ /de nas nang du 'ongs te/

rang nyid skad cig gis hūṃ mdzad sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching ba/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ rdo rje'i shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwā sa ma ya/ zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bskor ba lan gsum bya/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi hi hī/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ gis me tog 'bul/ oṃ badz+rod gha ḍa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes lan bzhi brjod la sgo dbye/ oṃ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/ zhes pas me tog rang gi mgo la bcing*/ oṃ pra na ma mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta/ zhes pas phyag bya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig /zhes gsol ba gdab/ 'chi blu byed par 'dod na 'dul 'dzin dang paṇa chen gyi cho ga las 'byung ba ltar bya la/ de yang 'dul 'dzin pa'i der skabs 'di dang*/ paṇa chen gyis dbang gi mjug tu bya bar bshad pas gang bde'o/ /de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ rang ngam slob ma khrus byas/ me tog thogs te/ yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyed bdag ston pa pas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug tu gsol/ /zhes rjes zlos lan gsum byas te gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang ba'i mig dang*/ oṃ tsk+ṣā pa na dha bar man ye hūṃ/ zhes pa bcing*/ āḥkhaṃ bi ra hūṃ/ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtod cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bzhag

/de nas sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs la/ de'i spang bya mtha' dag spong zhing*/ bslab bya mtha' dag la bslab par bya snyam pa'i mos pa byas la rjes zlos mdzod ces brda sprad/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /ces pa nas/ 'grub par shog /zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ bya rgyud la rigs lnga'i sdom bzung med pas/ thams cad rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa ni/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ud pa ta ya mi/ zhes brjod du gzhug de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o/ /snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems kun rdzob pa de nyid snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i steng du chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa stong pa nyid dang slob ma'i sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga par gyur/ ces brjod de brda sprad/ rang gi mi len pa'i skabs yin na/ slob ma'i dod la rang zhes sbyor ba 'og ma kun la 'gre/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥ khaṃ bi ra hūṃ/ gis 'khrid/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod du bcug la nang du zhugs bar mos te/ na maḥte hūṃ/ na ma ཿme hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ/ zhes phyag bya/ gsum po la 'dul 'dzin pa'i der swā hā yang 'byung*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig

/bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas slob ma 'am rang*/ oṃ mṛ tas bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥmatshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las slob ma 'am rang nyid tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po byi ru'i mdog can 'od zer dmar po ces pa nas/ krung gis bzhugs pa'i snying khar hrīḥdamar pos mtshan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod zhes pa dang*/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad hrīḥdamar po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas khyed rang rnam pa'am rang gi lus la thim par gyur ces brda sprad/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas ngag tu hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra a be sha ya āḥ.āḥ.āḥ ces brjod cing rdo rje mgor bzung ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan par bya/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ zhes lha la me tog dbul/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na s+t+waṃ iṃ ma sa twa ma hā ba la/ sems dpa' stobs po che slob ma 'am bdag byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rjes su gzung shog /zhes me tog mgo la bcing*/ oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu bha na dha hūṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes pas mig dar dbye/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes brjod de rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag ston/ ston tshul ni/ rdor ra mi ri nas gtso bo'i bar rim par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar brtsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /de nas bum pa spyi bor bzung nas/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol ste/

/bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas/ /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ bai ro tsa na ā ur+dzña na sid dhe sa ma ya a bhi ṣī ñtsa hūṃ/ 'dir bu khyod zhes pa rang la dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin na/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pas gsung par mos dgos so/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /mi yi seng ge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs te/ /snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa ni/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sgra ni grags par 'gyur/ /sbyin pa mthar phyin tshe ni 'phel bar shog /zhes brjod de bum chu blud cing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga zhes pa nas/ wā re swā hā/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang gti mug gi dbang gis srog gcad pa'i sdig pa ma lus pa dag /lus rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi ngo bor gyur/ chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas las la rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur/ nas cig /oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā nas hūṃ/ tshul khrims nas zhe sdang gi dbang gis= lus rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi nas mi bskyod pas= lus la rin chen tshe dbang nas cig /oṃ rat+na ā yur+dzñā nas hūṃ/ bzod pa'i nas nga rgyal ser sna'i dbang gis= lus rin chen tshe dpag med kyi nas rin chen 'byung ldan= lus la pad+ma'i tshe dbang nas cig /oṃ pad+ma ā nas hūṃ/ brtson 'grus nas 'dod chags kyi dbang gis= lus pad+ma tshe dpag med nas 'od dpag med= lus la las kyi tshe dbang nas cig /oṃ karma ā nas hūṃ/ bsam gtan nas shog /ces dang*/ shes rab stobs kyis nas phrag dog gi dbang gis srog gcod pa'i sdig pa= lus las kyi tshe dpag nas don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes dbang bskur ro/ /'dir 'dul 'dzin pa'i pad+ma tshe dpag med rin chen gyi sngon du 'byung pa/ paṇa chen gyi der rin chen sngon du 'byung bas 'gal ba med par snang yang*/

spyi 'gro dang bstun na phyi ma bde bar sems pas de ltar bya'o/ /'o na 'dul 'dzin pas go rim de ltar 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ de ni dug gsum sbyong tshul lhan cig tu bkod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin 'ang go rim de kho na nyid byed par ma nges pa gzhung du ma las shes so/ /yang na cig shos ltar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa gnyis sogs yod na rnam rgyal bum pa nas las bum du chu cung zad blugs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ zhes sogs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la khrus gsol zhing de'i chu 'ang las bum du cung zad blugs te/ de slob ma'i sdig sgrib sogs bkrus par bsams nas/ snying po dang las thams cad pa'i gsham du che ge mo'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṅku ru ye swā hā/ nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te rims thams cad=/ gdon= nye bar 'tshe ba= dus ma yin pa'i 'chi = 'khon= grib= bdud= byur dang skal pa dan pa= ltas ngan pa= mtshan ma= rmi lam= bkra mi shis= mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon= bdud kyi zhags pa= gshin rje'i pho nya= bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lan mang du bkru'o/ /de nas kha ru chu cung zad bzung zhing*/ bkrus pa'i lhag ma lus pa rnams cu der 'pho bar bsam nas/ rma bya'i sgros byabs shing*/ snying po dang las sngags brjod pa'i rjes su/ che ge mo'i tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'phags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa ṇa ye swā hā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la thams cad ces pa re re'i mthar a pa ṇa ye swā hā/ zhes sbyar te brjod pa'i rjes su kha'i chu de sngar bkrus pa'i chu nang du 'dor ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ dzaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ nas la brten nas/ slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad khrus chu 'di dang lhan cig tu rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig

/gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis sreg cing rnam par 'joms pa gdon mi za'o/ /a mṛ ta dang*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūṃ/ ces pa nas/ badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing*/ gu gul gyis bdug /rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing*/ bkrus pa'i chu phyir 'dor ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa las/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal 'gyur rdzun ma lags/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig /dza ya dza ya/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ pha la pha la hoḥ zhes brjod cing*/ de nas sngags kyi rjes su/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā/ rak+ṣa ni srung ba'i don yin pas thams cad las zhes byas na bde'o/ /dbu rgyan yod na bskyed tshul ni/ paṇa chen gyi gsung ltar/ de bsangs sbyangs/ cod paṇa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥyongs su gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i cod pan du gyur ces bskyed par bya dgos so/ /med na so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan 'dis/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/

/sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ bud dha= oṃ rat+na= trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma= hrīḥ oṃ karmā= āḥ zhes dang*/ mdzes shing yid 'ong dar gyi cod paṇa 'dis/ /bskal ldan shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra pa tra a wa lam bha na a bhi ṣīñtsa traṃ/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i der dbu rgyan dang dar dbyangs gnyis ka la sngags tsam gyis 'grub par bshad cing*/ paṇa chen gyi deng yang rgyal srid ma gtogs tshigs bcad med kyang*/ 'dir mdzad pa ni rgyas pa'i lugs so/ /de nas rin chen sna bdun gyi gzugs bris pa yod na/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i der bskyed tshul bshad pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i sna bdun rnam pa 'khor lo sogs dang shing thogs pa med pa ngo bo ye shes las grub par gyur par bsam la/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa maṃ/ zhes 'khor lo sbyin/ de bzhin du rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūr+ya/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*/ /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pas= /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na= / gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang la/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ btsun mo rin chen/ oṃ sti= gang yang rgyal ba mu tig mdangs ldan pas/ /gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan te/ /blon po rin chen= oṃ pu ru ṣa= yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs chen ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/

/gleng po= oṃ ha sdi= tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog 'gyur ba/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong pa'i/ /rta mchog = oṃ tu raṃ ga a shwa= 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur ba'i/ /bdud dpung ma lus 'jigs par byed pa ste/ /dpal ldan 'byor ba'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /dmag dpon rin chen dam pas= oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na=maṃ/ zhes rin chen sa bdun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas nyungs kar la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad ras dkar po sogs gzhi gtsang mi'i steng du bzhag la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las grub pa'i bkra shis kyi rdzas nyungs kar la sogs pa brgyad la reg pa tsam gyis bkra mi shis pa sel ba'i rdzas su gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ maṅga la aṣ+ta dra bya swā hā/ zhes snying pos byin gyis brlabs te/ yungs kar lag tu thogs nas/ sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul te/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir yang slob ma rnams nyungs kar gyis rdzas la brten nas tshe ring zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa yi/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs par gyur pa'i bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi bar shog /ces sbyin no/ /de bzhin du dur ba thogs te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la/ rtswa 'tshong gi khye'u bkra shis kyis rtswa dur ba ces pa nas/ gyur cig /dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni zab bsgrubs nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe rnams 'phel bar shog /zhes sbyin no/ /bil pa thogs te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing thog bil ba ces pa nas/

cig /bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur ldan pa ste/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa rnams/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don rnams kun 'grub shog /zhes sbyin no/ /ghi hang thogs te/ sngon= glang po che nor skyong gi sman ghi hang ces pa nas/ ghi haṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtags gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig /ces sbyin no/ /li khri thogs te/ sngon= bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus sman li khri ces pa nas/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang*/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyad srid brtan gyur cig /ces sbyin no/ /zho thogs te/ sngon= zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho= ces pa nas/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po yang dag ye shes mchog rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /ces sbyin no/ /me long thogs te/ /sngon= gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long ces pa nas/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /ces byin no/ /dung thogs te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil pa phyag tu phul te/ ces pa nas/ gyur cig /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur nas/ /chos rnams ma lus ston par byed pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog /ces sbyin no/ /de nas rang ngam khyed rang rnams tha mal du gnas pa'i snying khar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi yod pa'i lte bar rnam snang tshe dpag med/

/mdun du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ g.yas su rin chen tshe= rgyab tu pad+ma tshe= g.yon du las kyi tshe= spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med rnams bzhugs par gyur/ yang na sku mdog sogs rgyas par brda sprad/ bla ma gtso bo'am rnam snang tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ye shes tshe dpag med 'phros te/ rang ngam khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i ye shes tshe dpag med la thim pas 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun du gyur/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ snying kha'i rigs lnga'i tshe dpag med la thim pas/ de rnams kyang zhu ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad khyab cing gang bas lus kyi zung dang sems kyi rten du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brda sprad de/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ ces pa nas/ wā re swā hā/ de ltar lan gsum mam gcig byas te/ rang ngam slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ ye shes tshe dpag med kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu brnyas pa spang bar gyis/ /'chi bdag chen po ngas bcom pas/ /bu khyod tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ / ces brjod de byin gyis brlob bo/ /de nas bka' drin gyi ched du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ spyir rgyud sde bzhi po gang gi'ang dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur bar ma zad/ lho sgo'i cho ga yang byang rung ste/ kun rig ṭīka chen las/ rnal 'byor bla med sogs kyi dkyil 'khor gzhan gyi sgo nas gshin po'i don du cho ga byed par 'dod na yang*/ rnam shes dgug pa sogs kyi bden stobs brjod pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang yin pa'i mtshan dang*/ rtsa rig gi gnas su rang rang gi yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ lho sgo'i cho ga gzhan thams cad 'di bzhin du byas la bdag mdun gi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba sogs rang rang gi gzhung las 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ tshe dpag med la brten nas lho sgo byed na bden stobs brjod pa'i tshe/

/bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs zhes 'don pa bsgyur zhing*/ tshe ldan gyi don du yin na/ rtsa rig gi dod la gzungs 'don pa dang*/ tshe 'das yin na yig brgya spyi 'gro ltar bzla/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo zhes sogs lta bu dang*/ tshe 'das la shi nas tshe dpag med kyi zhabs drung du skyed zhes dang*/ sarba bid oṃ sogs kyi dod du tshe 'das kyi spyi bor oṃ sogs kyang 'thad/ lhag ma gzhan phyag len mthong rgyud ltar bya'o/ /de yang ṭīka chen gyi bla med rnal 'byor sogs zhes pa'i sogs sgras rgyud sde gzhan gsum sdud par go dgos shing*/ cang gyā zhabs drung gis kyang de'i dgongs pa blangs nas gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang tshe dpag med kyi sgo nas lho sgo'i cho ga bya dgos tshul bshad pas/ kha cig bya rgyud kyi skabs su lho sgo byar mi rung snyam pa ni/ rang nyid mang du thos pa dang mi ldan pa'am/ bla ma'i man ngag med pa'i nang rtags ston pa'o/ /der ma zad/ lho sgo byed pa'i tshe bdag mdun bum gsum tshang bar dgos mod/ dmigs bsal bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed tsam gyis kyang rung ngo*/ /bum bskyed rgyas pa ma lcogs pa'i tshe'ang gzungs bum bsgrub par bya ste/ khrus bum tsam yang ma bsgrub par lho sgo'i cho ga byed pa ni sla chos su song ba'o/ /de'i phyir tshe 'das kyi don du dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i cho ga byas nas lho sgo mi byed pa ni dgos pa'i gtso bo stor ba yin te/ cang gyā zhabs kyis/ gshin po'i dge ba la gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi cho ga zhe dgu'i bar du gsungs pa phan yon shin tu che la/ de dang 'brel ba'i lho sgo'i cho ga byas na sdig sgrib sbyong ba sogs kyi nus pa dang phan yon lhag par che bas tshe 'das la snying brtse ba dag gis ni tshul 'di lta bu la brtson par rigs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/de nas gtar rag gi mchod pa sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs bskyed de/ 'bul ba ni/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ a pa ri nas ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung byas nas/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyed de kun bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis par/ / 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzod rigs/ /ces pas bzod gsol bya/ spro na/ 'ga' zhig nas 'byung ba ltar/ lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*/ /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*/ /bdag gis brjed ngas ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyon pa'i nus mthu/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mnga' ba lags pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyi 'byung ba/ khyad par du yang bdag sogs sbyin pa'i bdag po'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngau bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ phyi mar yang bde ba can du skyes nas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bar byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ gnas skabs su bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag las dang po pa sems bying rgod kyi dbang gis cho ga lhag pa chad pa/ mchod pa'i yo byad ngan zhing ma tshang ba/ sngags ma dag pa/ ting nge 'dzin ma gsal ba la sogs pa/ 'khrul zhing nongs pa'i tshogs ci bgyis pa de dag thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po khyed rnams kyis thugs bzod pa dam pa mdzod la bdag cag gi tshe 'di la bar chad med cing*/

phyi ma la gnong pa'i sdig sgrib mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gi 'bras bu stsol/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod pa'i/ /dngos grub bla na med pa stsol/ /ces 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ rdul tshon yin na/ nyin snga ma rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*/ phyi ma'i tshe yi ge brgya pa brjod cing dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba byas la/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyis mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bstan pa rgyas pa la sogs pa'i don du bsngo zhing*/ de nas a ka ro brjod cing dril bu gsol te/ dang po lha mtshan rnams bsdu/ de nas tshangs thig nas brgya mas lte ba'i bar dang re kha rdo rje'i rtse mos bshig rdul tshon rnams phyags te bum par blugs la mchod pa dang bcas khyer nas rgya mtsho 'bab pa'i chu bor 'dor ro/ /bum pa chus bkang la 'ongs te/ dkyil 'khor gi khang pa la zhi ba shis pa'i don du gtor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra kī la ud kī la ya sarba kī la na badz+ra dha ra ad dzñā pa ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa hoṃḥ ces brjod de phur bu rnams dbyung ngo*/ /oṃ ru ru sku ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid dha lo tsa na sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes sogs bzlas te phur bu rnams bkrus pas bgegs rnams sos te sangs rgyas par gyur cig /ces brjod/ ras bris yin na/ oṃ na mo bruṃ ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ.a ro lik+ka hūṃ hrīḥ mdun bskyed kyi spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi bris sku'i rnam par gyur nas ji srid 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa ma byung ba'i bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor ro/ /shis brjod rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ che ba'i che mchog sogs dang*/ dus min 'chi ba'i sogs dang*/

'dab bzang gtsug phud sogs dang*/ tshangs dang lha dbang sogs kyis shis brjod bya'o/ /ces tshe dpag med kyi cho ga'i 'don cha nas 'gros su bkod pa ni/ dad pa dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba'i dka' bcu pa blo bzang bsam 'grub dang*/ dge slong blo bzang dbang phyug gnyis kyi rang gzhan la phan 'dod kyi 'dun pas bskul ba'i tshe/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis/ 'dul 'dzin pas mdzad pa'i tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi bdag kun 'joms zhes grags pa la/ par ma gnyis snang ba las/ gcig 'dul 'dzin nyid kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga dngos dang*/ gcig ni de la cung zad kha skong byas pa zhig tu snang bas/ 'dir snga ma de gzhir byas pa yin na 'ang*/ de nyid nas 'byung ba'i 'chi blu'i skor dor/ paṇa chen gong mas mdzad pa'i tshe dpag med kyi cho ga sogs nas legs cha blangs te/ sngar dgon 'dir mchis pa'i 'don cha dang mthun par co ne bshad sgrub gling du bsgrigs pa ste cho ga 'di tshul bzhin du byas na/ gnas skabs tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing sdig sgrib 'dag pa dang*/ phyi ma bde ba can du skyes nas sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyis rjes su 'dzin pa sogs phan yon shin tu che ba'o/ /smras pa/ snyigs ma'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs kyi phul/ /bde ldan zhing gi 'dren pa tshe dpag med/ /gang de'i dkyil 'khor cho ga 'od dkar can/ /mtha' yas 'gro 'di'i phan bde'i dpal du shar/ /tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad las rnam dkar dge/ /gangs ri'i tog 'dra ji snyed thob de yang*/ gnas skabs tshe yi bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /phyi mar bde ba can du skye phyir bsngo/ /ces pa 'di yang gnas brtan blo bzang dbang phyug gis cho ga 'di par du brko bar bzhed pa'i tshe bskul ba ltar bgyis shing*/ par rko ba po ni de nyid kyi gcung 'jam dbyangs tshul 'khrims dang*/ yab ma ṇi 'bum gnyis so/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la phan thogs par gyur cig/sarba maṅgalaṃ//
